Description: Aepnus Technology develops technology to manufacture a range of commodity chemicals via the process of electrolysis. The company’s current focus is on the recycling of sodium sulfate waste, ubiquitous across the battery supply chain, into usable reagent chemicals: sodium hydroxide and sulfuric acid. We’re developing a technology platform to electrify and decarbonize the production of various commodity chemicals. Our beachhead market and main technical focus is on applications within the battery industry. Namely the conversion of sodium sulfate waste into valuable sodium hydroxide and sulfuric acid.
